fields.label: Also Serves
fields.description: Other departments this machine runs work for, one per line. M1-M4 print Computer Paper AND Reel to Reel on the same press, and one press must not become two records - that would split its history in half. The department above stays its home; this widens where it can be picked.
Lower numbers show first on the production screen. Leave at 0 to sort by name.
fields.label: Display Order

fields.description: Workstation Type is the stage vocabulary ERPNext already holds - 21 of them, ordered by custom_stage_position. This is where a floor machine says which stage it serves.
fields.label: ERPNext Alignment
Stage
fields.description: Which production stage this machine or process serves. Ordered on the board by the Workstation Type's own custom_stage_position. Blank is allowed - Monobox's stages do not exist as Workstation Types yet.

The physical machine in ERPNext. Left EMPTY for a department whose 'machines' are really stages (Carton, Monobox) - those carry a Stage and no Workstation, which is the honest shape rather than inventing a record.
